'''Jessk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ah, the Trandoshan. He cheated a few of our customers and it is hurting business. One of these customers is a friend of the owner, so we have taken it upon ourselves to solve the problem.|[[Tien Wallub]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:I" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jessk resided some time in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. During that time, he patronized a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in Kachirho where he played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="SWG:I" /> However, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Jessk was catch cheating with other customers, including with a friend of the cantina's owner. The owner then decided to take it upon himself to solve the problem. One of his employees, [[Tien Wallub]], placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the Trandoshan via [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Bounty [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Stren Colo]].<ref name="SWG:I" /> Jessk was forced to flee Kashyyyk and he moved to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, he quickly attracted much attention to himself while cheating in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]]. A [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was pursuing Jessk from Kashyyyk then discussed with a cheated gambler and thus managed to trace the Trandoshan. The bounty hunter tracked Jessk in the [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Mesric Plateau]] and finally killed the Trandoshan in the ensuring fight.<ref name="SWG:JtT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jessk appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jessk was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:JtT" />
